Population 94 · Friday

WRENHAVEN

The M.V. June Bell has just let you off at the pier, suitcase in hand. The rain is doing whatever it wants. Your rented house is up on Lantern Road — and your key, you've been told, is waiting at the general store, with Elsie Bell.

Walk with WASD, the arrow keys, or a tap. Press E — or use the button — to talk and to go through doors. The town keeps its own hours; it will not wait for you, and it remembers.
